No actionable comments were generated in the recent review. 🎉 --- ## Walkthrough TLS profile groups now propagate to Apache curve environment variables and BMO curve-preference arguments. Unsupported groups are logged, TLS 1.3-only configurations omit cipher-suite arguments, tests cover conversions and wiring, and Go module dependencies are updated. ### Changes **TLS curve propagation** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Curve conversion and provisioning outputs**
`provisioning/tls_profile.go`, `provisioning/tls_profile_test.go`|TLS groups are converted to OpenSSL and supported Go curve names, emitted through Apache variables and BMO arguments, and tested for filtering, empty inputs, hybrid groups, and TLS 1.3 behavior.| |**Unsupported group logging**
`controllers/provisioning_controller.go`, `provisioning/tls_profile.go`|Unsupported TLS groups are logged when the controller retrieves the API server TLS profile.| **Dependency refresh** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Module version updates**
`go.mod`|OpenShift, Kubernetes, Go, OpenAPI, and indirect module requirements are upgraded, normalized, or removed.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~25 minutes ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant TLSProfileSpec participant tlsProfileToApacheEnvVars participant tlsProfileToBMOArgs TLSProfileSpec->>tlsProfileToApacheEnvVars: provide Groups tlsProfileToApacheEnvVars->>tlsProfileToApacheEnvVars: convert to OpenSSL curves tlsProfileToApacheEnvVars-->>TLSProfileSpec: set Apache curve environment variables TLSProfileSpec->>tlsProfileToBMOArgs: provide Groups and TLS settings tlsProfileToBMOArgs->>tlsProfileToBMOArgs: map supported Go curve names tlsProfileToBMOArgs-->>TLSProfileSpec: set BMO curve-preference arguments ``` **Possibly related issues** - `openshift/controller-runtime-common` issue 20: Covers related TLS group handling for Go `tls.Config.CurvePreferences`, while this change handles Apache and BMO provisioning paths. **Possibly related PRs** - [openshift/cluster-baremetal-operator#633](https://github.com/openshift/cluster-baremetal-operator/pull/633): Shares the Apache TLS environment-variable wiring extended by this change. **Suggested reviewers:** `zaneb`, `honza`

🧹 Nitpick comments (1)
provisioning/tls_profile.go (1)
`60-101`: _📐 Maintainability & Code Quality_ | _🔵 Trivial_ | _⚡ Quick win_ **Unsupported/unknown TLS groups are silently dropped with no diagnostic.** `tlsGroupsToOpenSSLCurves` and `tlsGroupsToGoNames` filter out any `TLSGroup` not in their allow-list/map with no log or return signal, unlike the webhook path in `main.go` which explicitly logs `unsupportedGroups`. If a cluster's TLS profile specifies a group not yet supported by Apache/Go (e.g. a future PQC group before this code is updated), operators configuring ironic-proxy/BMO curve preferences get no indication that part of their configuration was ignored. Consider having these functions (or their callers) surface the filtered-out groups, e.g. via a `klog.Warningf`, mirroring the pattern already used in `main.go` for the webhook TLS config.

Preserve the current supported-group conversion while clearly reporting ignored groups, including groups unsupported by the current Apache or Go implementation, consistent with the webhook handling in main.go. ```
